title: Control Room: Broadcast + Pass
description: Run a structured discussion where every agent sees every turn. Each discipline contributes once per round or uses the pass tool when it has nothing new to add. No agent-to-agent addressing; the shared ledger and step gates keep the conversation coherent. Re-open it from the 🪄 icon.

entries.label: Start the broadcast-and-pass discussion
entries.description: Watch every agent receive each turn, contribute by discipline, or pass cleanly before the next round.
